intro: Monasteries, mountain lakes and Himalayan views. That is Gangtok in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Gangtok
paragraphs: Gangtok (Sikkim) is known for its mountain, nature and culture experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to May and October to December.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly to Bagdogra or take a train to New Jalpaiguri, then about 4 hours by road.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Permits for Nathula and North Sikkim are arranged through registered agents — book a day ahead.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Gangtok?
faq.a: March to May and October to December.
Fly to Bagdogra or take a train to New Jalpaiguri, then about 4 hours by road.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Gangtok?
faq.a: Popular choices: Near MG Marg for convenience; Tadong for quieter hotels.
